explanation: PS stands for post scriptum, from Latin post, after, and scribere, to write, which also gave English script and scribble. A second afterthought becomes PPS.

claims.text: PS stands for Latin post scriptum, 'written after'.
PS does not stand for phrases meaning please see, personal seal or private note.
Post scriptum comes from Latin post, 'after', and scribere, 'to write'.
'Script' and 'scribble' also come from Latin scribere.
A second postscript is marked PPS, for post-postscript.
